proposals.rationale: This pre-turn hook parses the decoded public payload, requires string msg and sig fields, verifies the exact msg bytes with ssh-keygen using namespace mshkn and root's pinned Ed25519 public key, and asserts ssh:mike only on success. Invalid, malformed, or unsigned payloads fail closed.

verb.description: Authenticate public-door payloads signed by Mike's pinned SSH Ed25519 key in the mshkn namespace.
verb.dockerfile:
FROM mshkn-base
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends jq && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -eu' 'p=$1' 'd=$(mktemp -d)' 'trap '\''rm -rf "$d"'\'' EXIT HUP INT TERM' 'printf "%s" "$p" | jq -erj '\''if type == "object" and (.msg | type) == "string" and (.sig | type) == "string" then .msg else error("invalid payload") end'\'' > "$d/msg"' 'printf "%s" "$p" | jq -erj '\''if type == "object" and (.msg | type) == "string" and (.sig | type) == "string" then .sig else error("invalid payload") end'\'' > "$d/sig"' 'printf "%s\n" "mike ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIA0N9MFCw7jQoKSDhpaifVtGiStOti7YH5Ab4NuQ+gic" > "$d/allowed"' 'ssh-keygen -Y verify -f "$d/allowed" -I mike -n mshkn -s "$d/sig" < "$d/msg" >/dev/null 2>&1' 'printf "%s\n" mike' > /verify.sh
RUN chmod 0555 /verify.sh

FROM golang:1.24-alpine AS build
RUN printf '%s\n' 'package main' 'import("context";"errors";"fmt";"html";"io";"mime";"net";"net/http";"net/url";"os";"regexp";"strings";"time")' 'func valid(u *url.URL)error{if (u.Scheme!="http"&&u.Scheme!="https")||u.Hostname()==""{return errors.New("URL must be HTTP(S) with a host")};if u.User!=nil{return errors.New("URL credentials are not allowed")};return nil}' 'func dial(ctx context.Context,network,address string)(net.Conn,error){host,port,e:=net.SplitHostPort(address);if e!=nil{return nil,e};ips,e:=net.DefaultResolver.LookupIP(ctx,"ip",host);if e!=nil{return nil,e};for _,ip:=range ips{if !ip.IsGlobalUnicast()||ip.IsPrivate()||ip.IsLoopback()||ip.IsLinkLocalUnicast(){return nil,errors.New("host resolves to a non-public address")}};if len(ips)==0{return nil,errors.New("host has no address")};return (&net.Dialer{Timeout:10*time.Second}).DialContext(ctx,network,net.JoinHostPort(ips[0].String(),port))}' 'func main(){if len(os.Args)!=2{fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,"error: URL required");os.Exit(2)};u,e:=url.Parse(os.Args[1]);if e==nil{e=valid(u)};if e!=nil{fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,"error:",e);os.Exit(1)};tr:=&http.Transport{Proxy:nil,DialContext:dial,TLSHandshakeTimeout:10*time.Second};c:=&http.Client{Transport:tr,Timeout:20*time.Second,CheckRedirect:func(r *http.Request,v []*http.Request)error{if len(v)>=10{return errors.New("too many redirects")};return valid(r.URL)}};q,_:=http.NewRequest("GET",u.String(),nil);q.Header.Set("User-Agent","mshkn-page-title/1.0");q.Header.Set("Accept","text/html,application/xhtml+xml");r,e:=c.Do(q);if e!=nil{fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,"error:",e);os.Exit(1)};defer r.Body.Close();mt,_,_:=mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"));if mt!="text/html"&&mt!="application/xhtml+xml"{fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,"error: response is not HTML");os.Exit(1)};b,e:=io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body,2097153));if e!=nil||len(b)>2097152{fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,"error: HTML response exceeds 2 MiB or could not be read");os.Exit(1)};re:=regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)<title[^>]*>(.*?)</title>`);m:=re.FindSubmatch(b);if len(m)<2{fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,"error: page has no title");os.Exit(1)};tags:=regexp.MustCompile(`(?s)<[^>]*>`);title:=strings.Join(strings.Fields(html.UnescapeString(tags.ReplaceAllString(string(m[1]),"")))," ");if title==""{fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,"error: page has no title");os.Exit(1)};fmt.Println(title)}' > /main.go
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /page-title /main.go
FROM mshkn-base
COPY --from=build /page-title /page-title
